_comment: Sheet group names -> department slot. The short code (ЕСЦ1 …) is what goes into the sheet's drop-down; any name containing «ЕСЦ<число>» (a full CRM name) is matched by that number (see systems/Groups.ts) — add a full CRM name to `mapping` only if one is not recognised. The look of the hero standing in a slot is NOT fixed here: it is chosen in the admin page (tab «Герои») and defaults to heroRoster.json. `leaders` — the group leader on each nameplate («ЕСЦ1 • Фамилия И.»): only the defaults (empty: the plate then shows just the code), the admin page edits them at run time (tab «Герои»). Surname + initial only — this file is public.
